item.text:
**Verdict**
- **Mixed, leaning no clear net improvement.** Scholz’s government often responded to crises with police/justice action, anti-hate enforcement, and restrained rhetoric. But 2024 still saw major domestic violence incidents, coalition collapse, and a constitutional warning about overbroad surveillance. I did not find a source that demonstrates citizens were clearly safer by year-end than at the start of 2024.

**Claim-Level Evidence**
| Direction | Source | Date | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Supportive | [Bundeskanzler Scholz zur aktuellen Sicherheitslage](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/scholz-sicherheitslage-2291096) | 2024-06-06 | After the Mannheim killing and major flooding, Scholz framed safety as a core state duty, said police and justice would respond decisively, and urged people not to let fear take over. This is direct evidence of a restraint-and-protection response to a domestic crisis. | 3B.10; 3B.9; 3B.6 |
| Supportive | [Bundesweites Vorgehen gegen Hasspostings](https://www.bka.de/DE/Presse/Listenseite_Pressemitteilungen/2024/Presse2024/240606_PM_Hasspostings.html) | 2024-06-06 | The BKA coordinated over 130 nationwide measures against hate postings, with more than 70 searches and many cases linked to right-wing, antisemitic, and threat-based content. This supports a claim that the state actively suppressed politically motivated online violence and intimidation. | 3B.10; 3B.8 |
| Supportive | [Germany tightens security and asylum policies after deadly festival stabbing](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-tightens-security-and-asylum-policies-after-deadly-festival-stabbing-3593588) | 2024-08-29 | After the Solingen stabbing, the government announced tighter security and asylum measures. This is evidence of a crisis response aimed at reducing future deaths and injuries, though it also shows the government was reacting to ongoing insecurity rather than preventing it in advance. | 3B.10; 3B.7 |
| Supportive | [Scholz urges unity, tolerance, and opposition to right-wing extremism](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/kanzler-kompakt-against-hatred-for-humanity-and-order-2254034) | 2024-01-20 | Scholz explicitly defended Germany’s migrant-background population, urged unity and tolerance, and opposed right-wing extremism. This cuts against scapegoating and supports a safer environment for vulnerable communities. | 3B.10; 3B.7; 3B.8 |
| Supportive | [Scholz calls for cool heads to pull Germany out of political crisis](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-voters-and-opposition-keep-heat-on-scholz-for-early-election-3710828) | 2024-11-08 | In the coalition crisis, Scholz called for a calm debate over early-election timing rather than inflammatory escalation. This is relevant to domestic stability, but it is more about crisis management than actual protection from violence. | 3B.10; 3B.9 |
| Counterweight | [Explainer-German coalition collapses: What comes next?](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936) | 2024-11-06 | Scholz’s firing of Lindner collapsed the coalition and triggered political chaos. This materially worsened domestic instability and undercut any simple claim that citizens were safer at the end of 2024. | 3B.10; 3B.6; 3B.9 |
| Counterweight | [The Federal Intelligence Service’s powers to conduct strategic surveillance of international telecommunications are unconstitutional in part](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) | 2024-11-08 | The Constitutional Court found parts of the BND surveillance framework unconstitutional and said oversight was inadequate. This is the main structural counterweight: it shows an overbroad security apparatus still existed under Scholz, even if that is not proof of a targeted crackdown on peaceful dissent. | 3B.10; 3B.8; 3B.6 |
| Counterweight | [AP: Germany’s Taurus leak security incident](https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c) | 2024-03-04 | The leaked military call became a real security incident and prompted investigation. This increased tension and misperception risk, so it is a genuine negative on domestic security discipline even though the government responded institutionally. | 3B.10; 3B.6; 3B.9 |

**Search Gap**
- I did **not** find a single authoritative 2024 source that cleanly quantifies whether Germans were net safer at year-end than at the start of the year across violence, displacement, and political insecurity.
- The evidence base is mostly incident-driven: Mannheim, Solingen, coalition collapse, the Taurus leak, and surveillance rulings, plus responsive enforcement. That supports a judgment on **response quality**, but not a strong claim that domestic safety objectively improved overall.
